newsitem.title: USA: Georgia to sell $257 million GOs on Aug. 5.
newsitem.headline: Georgia to sell $257 million GOs on Aug. 5.

text.p: Georgia will sell two series of general obligation bonds totalling $256.875 million by competitive bid at 11 a.m. EDT on Aug. 5, the State Financing and Investment Commission said.
The bonds are $16.435 million of Series 1997 B bonds with maturities out to five years and $240.44 million of Series 1997 C bonds with maturities out to 20 years. Both series are non-callable.
The issues will fund a variety of capital projects approved by the General Assembly in the amended 1997 appropriations bill and the 1998 general appropriations bill.
